result.message:
That immediate trade can’t be added to the Boston signing as written. Seth’s one-year contract does not meet sign-and-trade requirements, which require three or four years with the first year fully guaranteed. Boston also isn’t his prior team; a sign-and-trade would have to originate with Golden State.

The Boston signing scenario remains unchanged. A later trade would need signing-date eligibility review, and Seth’s $3.29 million salary alone would not match Andrew Wiggins’s $30.17 million salary for Boston.
